descriptionChirho: The proper noun Perets (פֶּרֶץ), meaning 'breach,' names the son of Judah and Tamar (Gen 38:29), ancestor of David and ultimately in the Messianic lineage (Ruth 4:18, 1 Chr 2:4). All three clusters represent the same personal name in different syntactic positions: nominative/accusative (S128731), conjunctive 'and Perez' (S128732), and prepositional 'to Perez' (S128733). Translations uniformly identify one person: English 'Perets/Perez,' Spanish 'Perez/Fares,' Hindi 'Peres' (पेरेस), Arabic 'Farasa' (فَارَصَ), Korean 'Bereseu' (베레스), Swahili 'Peresi/Pereza.' The variation in spelling (Perets vs. Perez) reflects transliteration conventions, not different referents.
